name: Hollowmoor
source:
The villagers told me not to take the job – that the last governess disappeared. I didn’t believe them then. 

Now I see her name carved into the windowpane of my room...

[From [url=https://asterielab.itch.io/hollowmoor]Itch.io[/url]]
